release: PLACEHOLDER: Fedora Remix for OnePlus Pad 4, B150g (<tag>; no generic release exists yet)
notes: TEMPLATE. Every PLACEHOLDER makes Install-Pad4Linux.ps1 refuse to download that file, and flash_allowed=false / generic=false / contains_unit_data=true make it refuse write 1 and write 2. Backups (read only) work with this file.

The owner's install image (B149, fedora-iceland.sparse.img, SHA-256 2246e9a7e790253be72ad8948cc3fa9f39bdcadfaa422ad53ed77daa6167482c) is NOT publishable and must never be written to another tablet: it carries the owner's sensor calibration registry (from persist), Bluetooth address (/etc/iceland/bdaddr) and firmware extraction record. See README-INSTALLER.md section 2.

GENERIC IMAGE PATH (prepared, NOT built yet): 'Fedora Remix for OnePlus Pad 4' B150g = the B149 recipe without unit data (no /etc/iceland/bdaddr, no extraction record; machine-id / host keys / journal / caches reset; first-boot wizard kept, no test user, no autologin) + kernel q89k (kernel-iceland 7.3.0~rc7.iceland.00436), iceland-device 0.28-17 (iceland-provision: the Bluetooth address; iceland-grow: the root fills userdata), iio-sensor-proxy 3.9-11.iceland1, iceland-firmware 11.A.38-3. The sensor registry stays in the image. The image is SMALL (about 12.8 GiB unpacked) and grows into userdata on its first boot (systemd-repart + growfs, checked / repaired once by iceland-grow), so one image fits every storage size: the installer requires partition-size:userdata >= image.min_userdata_bytes.

Fill this file from the image build's image-manifest.json (file, size, sha256, parts[] with name / size / sha256; urls stay PLACEHOLDER until the release exists). flash_allowed stays false until (1) the privacy scan reports PRIVSCAN: PASS on that exact image, (2) a rehearsal of that image passed (first-boot wizard, iceland-provision line, Bluetooth, sensors), (3) the maintainer clears the release.

Bluetooth: the Backup phase reads the tablet's own address read-only from Android (adb shell getprop persist.vendor.service.bdroid.bdaddr, the only property added to the whitelist), saves it as bdaddr.txt next to backup-manifest.json (private, masked in logs) and prints 'sudo iceland-provision --bdaddr <address>' for Fedora's first login. Writing it into the image before write 1 was rejected: the image is an Android sparse file, the EFI partition inside it would have to be rewritten from Windows and the image's SHA-256 would no longer be the published one.
GitHub release assets are limited to 2 GiB each: the image goes up in parts (parts[]), joined and checked against image.sha256 on the PC.

device.userdata_bytes_note: userdata_bytes is the storage size of the unit the B149 image was made on, used only for an image without image.min_userdata_bytes (B149); a generic image needs userdata >= image.min_userdata_bytes

image.unpacked_size: PLACEHOLDER: = min_userdata_bytes (the small disk; about 13717471232 for a B149-sized root)
image.min_userdata_bytes: PLACEHOLDER: the small disk size from the image build
image.content: PLACEHOLDER: B150g generic: kernel-iceland 7.3.0~rc7.iceland.00436.gf1673c99e731 (q89k), iceland-device 0.28-17, iio-sensor-proxy 3.9-11.iceland1, iceland-firmware 11.A.38-3
image.privacy_scan: PLACEHOLDER: the privacy scan's result line for this image (must be PRIVSCAN: PASS) and the report's SHA-256
image.rehearsal: PLACEHOLDER: the rehearsal of this image (date, summary line)
image.first_boot: iceland-grow.service: the root partition and btrfs fill userdata (once; one journal line 'iceland-grow: ...'). iceland-provision.service: the Bluetooth address from the tablet if it can (U-Boot device tree / a persist file, read only), else one warning; then run the installer's line once: sudo iceland-provision --bdaddr XX:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX

uboot_plain.source: iceland-u-boot, U-Boot commit e0300255 + queue 0004-0012 (v4: charging-mode reader + key menu), install build, header v4 os_version 17.0.0 patch 2026-09; built 2026-10-14

uboot_footered.source: uboot_plain + AVB hash footer (avbtool add_hash_footer, partition boot, 100663296 bytes, SHA256_RSA4096, AOSP testkey_rsa4096, salt = sha256 of uboot_plain); values copied from the owner's LineageOS (Android 17, test-keys) boot_b of 29 Sep 2026. Used as-is only when the user's boot_b has the same rollback index / os_version / security_patch; otherwise the script makes the footer locally.
